findings.title: Apply the website visibility restriction to website_name
findings.body: The new website_name attribute is not included in untrusted_attributes, so it is serialized even when scope.restrict_user_fields?(object) hides website for an anonymous visitor viewing a TL0 user. It exposes the hidden website's hostname (and path for same-domain URLs), and the updated template now displays that value despite the website itself being omitted. Add website_name to the same visibility guard as website; the new include_website_name method neither follows the include_website_name? hook naming convention nor checks this restriction.

findings.title: Refresh the server-derived website label after editing preferences
findings.body: The template now uses the server-derived website_name instead of a computed property dependent on model.website, but User.save() only copies bio_excerpt from the update response. Editing the website in preferences therefore changes model.website without changing website_name on the existing user model. Returning to the profile can show the old hostname linked to the new URL, or no website at all if none was previously set, until the user details are fetched again. Update website_name from the save response or otherwise refresh it when the website changes.
